scheme2_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Retirement savings & guaranteed old-age pension for unorganised-sector workers
comparisons.scheme2_value: Free food grain support for poor & migrant families during financial hardship

comparisons.scheme1_value: Monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 (your choice) from age 60 until death; spouse gets same pension after your death; nominee gets remaining savings
comparisons.scheme2_value: 5 kg free food grain per person per month (on top of subsidised ration); wheat or rice depending on your State

comparisons.scheme1_value: Age 18–40; not an income-tax payer; must have an active savings bank or post office account
comparisons.scheme2_value: Families with Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) ration card; includes widows, elderly without income, landless labourers, slum dwellers, daily-wage workers

comparisons.scheme1_value: Income-tax payers (from 1 Oct 2022 onwards) cannot join; if found later, account is closed
comparisons.scheme2_value: General ration card holders not eligible; only AAY and PHH cards work

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar (primary ID); mobile number for OTP; existing bank/post office savings account
comparisons.scheme2_value: Ration card; Aadhaar card (if linked to ration card)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online via net banking or eNPS portal (enps.nsdl.com); OR offline at bank/post office branch. Simple form with nominee details.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No separate application. Walk into any Fair Price Shop with your ration card; authenticate via Aadhaar fingerprint/iris; collect grain monthly

comparisons.scheme1_value: No deadline. Join anytime between ages 18–40. Contributions run until age 60.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No deadline. Collect grain every month from Fair Price Shops as long as you hold an eligible ration card

comparisons.scheme1_value: At age 60 onwards (pension starts then; continues for life)
comparisons.scheme2_value: Immediately after first visit to Fair Price Shop (ongoing monthly support)

comparisons.scheme1_value:
• Auto-debit contributions mandatory monthly/quarterly/half-yearly
• Keep enough bank balance; late payments attract fees & overdue interest
• Early exit before 60: you get back only your contributions + actual gains (not govt co-contribution)
• Tax deductible under section 80CCD(1)
comparisons.scheme2_value:
• Only AAY & PHH ration cards qualify (not general cards)
• Wheat allocated to 6 States/UTs; rice to rest of India
• 'One Nation One Ration Card' means migrants can collect grain anywhere in India
• Grain type fixed per State allocation

comparisons.scheme1_value: Young (18–40), non-tax-payer workers wanting guaranteed pension security at age 60
comparisons.scheme2_value: Poor families, migrant workers, elderly, widows, landless labourers, daily-wage earners needing immediate food support

recommendation:
These schemes serve **completely different needs**:

**Choose APY if:** You are a young, regular-income worker (not a tax payer) who wants to **save for retirement** and receive a guaranteed monthly pension starting at age 60. This is a **long-term investment in your future**.

**Choose PMGKAY if:** You are a poor family member, migrant, widow, elderly person, or daily-wage worker who needs **immediate help with food**. This is **direct food assistance** — no savings required.

**You can use BOTH:** If you are a young, low-income worker who is eligible for both, join APY for old-age security AND use your ration card for PMGKAY's free grain now. They do not conflict.

⚠️ **Disclaimer:** This is AI guidance based on official scheme documents. For final decisions, verify details at https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in (APY) and https://nfsa.gov.in (PMGKAY), or contact your bank/Fair Price Shop. This is not legal or financial advice.
